children: JGBs fall in early Tokyo trade, tracking overnight price declines in U.S. Treasurys. Both JGBs and Treasurys tend to move in tandem. The focus for today might be on the Japanese Finance Ministry's auction of about 700 billion yen of 20-year sovereign debt. "Although there was a strong rally in October, we think many investors feel their duration risk is not sufficient," Citi Research's Tomohisa Fujiki says in a research report. "We believe negative factors for the super-long sector are already priced in and the auction should attract sufficient demand," the rates strategist adds. The 20-year JGB yield is 1.5 bps higher at 3.785%. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
